title: Put the Speech Away  (スピーチ原稿をしまう)

segments.t: 三時五分前、フロントデスクでアーサーがネクタイをまっすぐに直しながら、ハンナとグラハムを前に五枚の原稿を必死に読み上げています。まずは会話全体を英語で聴いてみましょう。
'Esteemed municipal representative, for over eighty years this historic courtyard...'
Boss, if you talk like a tax textbook, the clerk will fall asleep standing up.
Take one deep breath, Arthur, and put all five pages in the drawer.
In the drawer?! Then what do I say when they walk through the gate?!
Say 'Good afternoon, welcome to Room Nine, please sit down for hot tea!'
Let the sunlit glass, Tessa's warm bread, and Evelyn's piano do the talking.
You really think simple hospitality is enough?
Hospitality is what this house has done best for over eighty years, Arthur.
Wait, are my reading glasses on my forehead right now?
Safely in your jacket pocket, boss. Tie straight, shoes clean.
Listen, the courtyard gate bell just rang! Three o'clock on the dot!
Deep breath... smile... let us go welcome our guest!
硬い原稿を手放して心のこもった歓迎へと切り替わる三人のやり取りを、一文ずつ表現に寄り添って確認します。
'Esteemed municipal representative, for over eighty years this historic courtyard...'
'『尊敬すべき市のご代表者様、八十年以上にわたりこの歴史ある中庭は……』'
Boss, if you talk like a tax textbook, the clerk will fall asleep standing up.
'社長、税金の教科書みたいな話し方をしたら、調査官が立ったまま眠ってしまいますよ。'
Take one deep breath, Arthur, and put all five pages in the drawer.
'アーサー、大きく深呼吸を一度して、その五枚の紙は全部引き出しにしまって。'
In the drawer?! Then what do I say when they walk through the gate?!
'引き出しにしまうのかい？！じゃあお客さまが門をくぐって入ってくるとき、私は何を言えばいいんだ？！'
Say 'Good afternoon, welcome to Room Nine, please sit down for hot tea!'
'こう言えばいいのよ。『こんにちは、九号室へようこそ、どうぞお座りになって温かい紅茶を召し上がってください』って！'
Let the sunlit glass, Tessa's warm bread, and Evelyn's piano do the talking.
'日当たりの良いガラスと、テッサの焼きたてパンと、エヴリンのピアノに語らせましょう。'
You really think simple hospitality is enough?
'素朴なおもてなしだけで本当に十分だと思うかい？'
Hospitality is what this house has done best for over eighty years, Arthur.
'アーサー、温かなおもてなしこそ、この宿が八十年以上いちばん得意としてきたことなのよ。'
Wait, are my reading glasses on my forehead right now?
'待てよ、今私の老眼鏡は額の上に乗っていないか？'
Safely in your jacket pocket, boss. Tie straight, shoes clean.
'胸ポケットに安全に収まっていますよ、社長。ネクタイよし、靴もぴかぴかです。'
Listen, the courtyard gate bell just rang! Three o'clock on the dot!
'聴いて、中庭の門のベルが今鳴ったわ！三時ぴったりよ！'
Deep breath... smile... let us go welcome our guest!
'深呼吸……笑顔……さあお客さまをお迎えしに行こう！'
さあ、自然体のおもてなしを語る表現を味わいながら、もう一度最初から場面を聴き直してみましょう。
'Esteemed municipal representative, for over eighty years this historic courtyard...'
Boss, if you talk like a tax textbook, the clerk will fall asleep standing up.
Take one deep breath, Arthur, and put all five pages in the drawer.
In the drawer?! Then what do I say when they walk through the gate?!
Say 'Good afternoon, welcome to Room Nine, please sit down for hot tea!'
Let the sunlit glass, Tessa's warm bread, and Evelyn's piano do the talking.
You really think simple hospitality is enough?
Hospitality is what this house has done best for over eighty years, Arthur.
Wait, are my reading glasses on my forehead right now?
Safely in your jacket pocket, boss. Tie straight, shoes clean.
Listen, the courtyard gate bell just rang! Three o'clock on the dot!
Deep breath... smile... let us go welcome our guest!
堅苦しいスピーチ原稿は引き出しにしまわれ、三時きっかりに門のベルが鳴って、アーサーは心からの笑顔でお客さまを迎えに出ます。次回をお楽しみに。
See you soon!
